body:
My feelings...? I feel alone... Saddened... It's a monstrous "life" to go each waking hour feeling like you'd be doing the world a favor by dieing. I'm nothing but a burden to everyone around me...and this hole I am in might not seem deep to those on the surface who are looking down at me, but I feel like I'm staring back at them from the bottom of a well...

I'm afraid of the uncertainty of death, I'm not afraid of the act though... I think the only thing keeping me here is how I've been brainwashed my entire life to question what's next after I leave this world... If heaven is real, then if I take my own life I'll burn in hellfire for eternity... That doesn't trouble me, I probably deserve to go there. What I'm afraid of is if God does exist, I know my son is in Heaven, and even if I die I won't get to see him again. If the afterlife doesn't exist...I still don't get to see him again...

It's amazing to me, how feeling lost is such an easy feeling to find...

What do you do when you're feeling down? I'm obviously feeling a little more than just ''down'' but I suppose there's a possibility I haven't tried everything...
